selection.screen_verdict: Smooth whitening does not rescue the factorized eigencoordinate representation. Gamma 0.25 improves FID by 21.70 over the rotation-only control, but remains 46.25 worse than native v27. The 67.95-FID rotation-only penalty shows that coordinate alignment and token semantics dominate the covariance-conditioning benefit.
